rationale: Both use *pieces with a keyword-only qualifier and zip(pieces, pieces[1:]) to build the lines, which is idiomatic and identical in substance. A makes the empty case explicit with an early return and builds the qualified first item in one conditional expression. B relies on the comprehension yielding nothing for empty input and guards the final line with an if block, using a nested if for the qualifier. The two are equally clear, correct and Pythonic, and neither has a meaningful quality advantage.
